priorTurns.text: Write me a short checklist for cutting a release of acme/app.

Release checklist:
1. Run vp run check:changed and fix failures.
2. Bump the version in package.json.
3. Write the changelog entry under docs/.
4. Tag the release and push the tag.
5. Watch the release workflow until it is green.
